scope: Shared read-only import acceptance validator; no stage teaching material or transaction tool was modified.

baseline_contract.matching: all five fields must match exactly
baseline_contract.inventory_fallback: When --baseline is known-diagnostics.json, sibling baseline.json supplies the original 8-file TaskNotes hashes.

coverage: explicit wrong-directory links do not fall back to a basename
fenced link and task examples are inactive
active #task/frontmatter task tags and dynamic .base embeds are detected
Canvas exact file targets, node ids, edge ids, and endpoints are validated
case-folded NFC collisions use the complete relative path
teaching exceptions are exactly two broken links, one island, three hashed snippets, and four static TaskNotes samples
a teaching exception cannot hide a different target, line, or reason
TaskNotes remains exactly eight baseline-identical files
raw originals, PDFs, and imported test files are checked against their fragment hashes
a Markdown table is recognized only by an adjacent header and valid delimiter row, with optional boundary pipes and physically continuous body rows
unescaped wikilink alias pipes are rejected only on recognized table rows; ordinary callouts, multiple inline wikilinks, math bars, and fenced examples are ignored
borderless Markdown tables still expose real unescaped wikilink alias errors
import manifests are discovered in development fragments, final artifacts, or the baseline parent without a directory-wide exemption
HTML code elements suppress embedded wikilinks while adjacent real links remain active
inline backtick code suppresses code-sync examples while adjacent real HTML code-sync markers remain active
.base YAML syntax is delegated to the existing Ruby/Psych format checker
existing links.py and check_mirrors.py behavior remains covered
